title: CMP: Update ASN.1 to RFC 9480
description:
Update the ASN.1 to the 1998 ASN.1 module provided in RFC 9480.
According to RFC 9480, "[a]lthough a 2002 ASN.1 module is provided, this
1988 ASN.1 module remains the normative module, as per the policy of the
PKIX Working Group." RFC 9810 obsoletes RFC 9480, but provides only an
update to the 2002 ASN.1 module. We were previously using the 1988 ASN.1
module from RFC 4210, not the 2002 ASN.1 module from RFC 5912.

Change the EXPORTS from CRMF and make other small changes to the CMP
conformance file. Note that we use CMS for some of the EXPORTS instead
of pkix1implicit.

Fix #21584

We could also perhaps update some of the other ASN.1 for more
certificate extensions mentioned in the attached capture file.

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
